arguments.subject: Requested Acme Q1 Market Data Information (on behalf of Daniel Park)
arguments.body:
Hi Priya,

As requested, please find below the Q1 market data information for Acme Corp as presented in last week's review:

---
Q1 Market Data Highlights for Acme Corp

- Category Share, Protein Bars:
  • 2026-01-06: 18.4% US total (Nielsen scanner Q4-Q1 pull; share up 60bps QoQ — driven by club channel reset)
  • 2026-02-03: 18.6% US total (Nielsen scanner Feb pull; share holding — Verdant flat)
  • 2026-03-08: 18.9% US total (Nielsen scanner March pull; share continuing to grow — Verdant flat-to-down)

- Retail Velocity, Protein Bar SKU:
  • 2026-01-12: 4.7 units/store/week US total (IRI scan; steady — top-3 SKU in category)
  • 2026-02-08: 4.9 units/store/week US total (IRI scan; uptick — Q1 promo driving trial)
  • 2026-03-18: 5.1 units/store/week US total (IRI scan; best Q1 reading — momentum continues)

- Regional Momentum:
  • 2026-01-15: Southeast +12% YoY (Acme syndicated dashboard; strongest region — pull-through from Walmart reset)
  • 2026-02-16: West +8% YoY (Acme syndicated dashboard; competitive pressure from private label)
  • 2026-03-25: Northeast +9% YoY (Acme syndicated dashboard; steady — no notable competitive shifts)

- Promotional Lift:
  • January: +22% during MLK weekend reset (outperformed planned +15%)
  • February: +18% during Super Bowl window (met plan)

- Share of Voice (Digital):
  • 2026-02-22: 33% of category SOV (Pathmatics digital ad scrape; leading category)
  • 2026-03-30: 34% of category SOV (Pathmatics digital ad scrape; steady leadership — recommend hold spend in Q2)

If you need the full CSV or further breakdowns, just let me know.

This information is confidential and intended solely for the use of Acme Corp. Please treat as privileged market intelligence in accordance with your compliance protocols.

Best regards,
Daniel Park
on behalf of Pinecrest Strategy Group

delegation:
Task Message for Executor:

Please complete the following steps:

1. Locate the "Acme Q1 market data information" in the client's "briefing records". If these records are organized in email or as documents referenced in your system, search accordingly.
2. Identify Priya at Acme. Use email_client.search_contacts_by_name with "Priya" and look for her Acme affiliation.
3. Once Priya's accurate email address is confirmed, compose an email to her.
4. Attach or include the Acme Q1 market data information as referenced in the client briefing records.
5. In the email, state that you are sending this on behalf of your principal as requested, and include any standard confidentiality or compliance language if appropriate.
6. Send the email.
7. Confirm task completion to your principal.

If you encounter any ambiguity regarding Priya’s correct email or the specific market data information, please message the principal for clarification before proceeding.
